fusions.name: Bucket Brigade
fusions.desc: Sprays the first enemy within 6 tiles for 10 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the damage. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Hobbling Blow
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Leashed to the Smell
fusions.desc: Lays a musk-soaked tether 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it, slows those it catches by 20% for 3 seconds and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pass It On
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a jet of musk flies to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage, then leaps to 1 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 3 seconds.
